title: WPMS/1843/2009 of RAJENDRA SINGH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND AND ORS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 1843 of 2009 (M/S)
Rajendra Singh, S/o Sri Iqbal Singh, R/o Village and P.O.
Tikolakalan, Pargana Manglore, Tehsil Roorkee, District
Haridwar. ÖPetitioner.
Versus
1. State of Uttarakhand through District Magistrate
Haridwar.
2. Settlement Officer Consolidation Roorkee, District
Haridwar.
3. Consolidation Officer Roorkee, District Haridwar.
4. Assistant Consolidation Officer, Manglore, Roorkee,
District Haridwar. Ö..Respondents.
Sri M.C. Kandpal, Senior Advocate with Sri S.S. Chaudhary, learned counsel
for the petitioner.
Mr. R.C. Arya, learned Brief Holder for the respondents.
Date:- November 19, 2009
Honíble B.S. Verma J.
 By means of this writ petition, the petitioner has
sought a writ in the nature of certiorari for quashing the
order dated 30-09-2009 passed by the Settlement Officer
Consolidation Roorkee, Haridwar (Annexure No.6) whereby
a direction was given for measurement of the Chaks of
Tikola Kalan Village Jathedi, Pargana Manglore, Tehsil
Roorkee, District Haridwar on the basis of some complaint.
 I have perused the order of the Settlement Officer
Consolidation. The order passed by the Settlement Officer
Consolidation is that the exchange of possession be made in
accordance with law after measurement. According to the
petitioner, this order has been passed in absence of the
petitioner, the measurement was made and possession had
been handed over on 09-04-2009.
 If the petitioner feels aggrieved by this order he
may also approach to the Settlement Officer Consolidation

2
or may file the application for recalling this Misc. order and
he may file the revision before the Deputy Director of
Consolidation to assail the order impugned.
 Section 48 of the U.P. Consolidation of Holdings
Act, 1953 provides that Deputy Director of Consolidation
may call for examine the record of any case decided or
proceedings taken by any subordinate authority.
 Since, the alternate statutory remedy is available
to the petitioner. I am not inclined to entertain the writ
petition. The writ petition is devoid of merits and is liable to
be dismissed.
 The writ petition is dismissed.
 The certified copy of the order be supplied to the
learned counsel for the petitioner by tomorrow on payment
of usual charges.
 (B.S. Verma, J.)
 19.11.2009
MK
